title: EON Stream remote addon manifest (v0 — UNSTABLE)
description: Manifest of a remote addon: an independent HTTP service returning JSON. It never runs code on the user's device (madde 4). This schema tracks the Stremio addon manifest so that existing addons validate unchanged; EON Stream's own additions live under the reserved 'eon' key and are always optional, so a Stremio client can ignore them and an addon stays usable in both. v0 is unstable.
$comment: additionalProperties is intentionally true: Stremio may add fields, and rejecting an addon over an unknown key would break compatibility — which is the whole point of this file.

id.description: Reverse-DNS identifier, immutable for the addon's life.

resources.description: Which endpoints the addon serves. A bare string means the resource applies to every declared type; the object form narrows it.

types.description: Content types served. 'movie', 'series', 'channel', 'tv' and 'other' are the Stremio set; EON Stream adds 'file', 'music' and 'package' for its own module kinds. An unknown type is not an error — a client ignores what it cannot display.

catalogs.description: Browsable catalogues. Required in practice when 'catalog' is in resources; an empty array is valid and means the addon serves no browsable catalogue.

extra.description: Supported query parameters: search, genre, skip, and addon-defined ones.

idPrefixes.description: Id prefixes the addon can answer for, e.g. 'tt' for IMDb ids. Used to avoid pointless requests.

eon.description: EON Stream extensions. Entirely optional: a Stremio client ignores this key, and a EON Stream client treats a missing key as 'not provided'. Nothing here may be required for basic playback, or two-way compatibility is lost.

minApi.description: Oldest EON Stream addon API version this addon works against.

maxApi.description: Newest major version the addon has been tested against. A client beyond this range still loads the addon but may warn.

mirrors.description: Additional HTTP sources for content the addon distributes itself, used as web seeds (BEP 19) so distribution survives the publisher going offline (madde 15d). HTTPS only.

license.description: SPDX identifier for content the addon serves itself. Ignored when the addon only points at third-party sources.

price.description: Reserved. No payment flow exists and none is implemented (madde 10). Present so the format need not be widened later.

signature.description: Detached signature, for addons distributed through the marketplace rather than added by URL. See docs/signing-and-revocation.md.

accessibility.description: What accessibility features the addon's own content provides (madde 35). Declaring nothing is honest; declaring falsely is a review finding.

education.description: Curriculum metadata, so that material can be found the way a teacher searches for it — '9. sınıf fizik' (madde 16a).

curriculum.description: Curriculum the metadata is aligned to, when it is aligned to one.
